habits.trigger: Before generating or tailoring a candidate CV
habits.action: Use only user-supplied current candidate facts and store candidate PII outside the public repository
habits.acceptance: No personal contact details, application credentials or real-candidate outputs committed

habits.trigger: When changing template design or renderer output
habits.action: Verify Latin Modern Roman A4 page count, extractable text, typography and visual preview
habits.acceptance: Measured output and relevant renderer tests support acceptance

habits.trigger: When rewriting achievements or role alignment
habits.action: Separate fictional reference examples from candidate claims, preserve measurement provenance and role requirements
habits.acceptance: No invented employment, credentials or numerical achievements
